penalties_applied.name: requires_human_fulfillment
penalties_applied.reason: Every installation requires a physical technician to visit the home and replace/modify hardware — this is irreducibly per-customer manual work.

penalties_applied.name: requires_physical_logistics
penalties_applied.reason: Service requires sourcing hardware (replacement modules, local-control boards), coordinating on-site visits, and physical installation — cannot be delivered digitally.

penalties_applied.name: requires_synchronous_human
penalties_applied.reason: Scheduling installation appointments and diagnosing specific garage door models requires synchronous coordination with each homeowner.

rationale: The buyer here is an individual homeowner — a consumer segment that is hard to reach at scale, price-sensitive, and faces this problem infrequently (garage door openers last years). The service is fundamentally a physical installation business: a technician must visit each home to replace or modify hardware, making it impossible to build or run autonomously with Claude and this factory's digital tooling. Even if a niche audience of privacy-conscious homeowners would pay, the unit economics of one-off hardware service calls do not support a scalable, hands-off digital business.
solution_plan: This would be a local smart-home retrofit service — someone physically visits a home, removes the cloud-dependent garage module, and installs a local-control replacement (e.g. Ratgdo or similar open hardware). The factory cannot build this: it requires physical hardware sourcing, hands-on installation at each property, and local technician networks. Selling it would mean reaching homeowners via NextDoor, local Facebook groups, or property manager forums — reachable but very manually. Every job is a synchronous, in-person appointment. There is no path to autonomous digital delivery here, and a solo non-technical operator in Israel has no geographic or logistical advantage for a US home-services play. Drop.
notes: Fails all build_gates: operational_autonomy (1), buildability_with_ai (1), buyer_clarity (4), willingness_to_pay (4). Intrinsically a physical service business; incompatible with this factory's model.
